candidates.title: Araxis Merge
candidates.summary: Araxis Merge for Windows version 2011.4074 through 2026.0 stores user-configured credentials for remote servers in the Windows registry and does not apply sufficient cryptographic protection. An authenticated, non-administrative user could retrieve and unencrypt other users' credentials.

candidates.title: Plex Media Server
candidates.summary: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861 contains multiple vulnerabilities. In the worst case, a remote attacker could steal a legitimate user's account credentials and eventually write arbitrary files or execute code.
